events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Pillaged Improvement

options.text: Never fear [character]! We shall avenge this grave insult with your brave Warrior.
I sympathize with your concerns [character], but we have enough men to handle these brigands.

events.text: Our city [city] has suffered a pillaged [improvement] Improvement at the hands of the monstrous [rival]! [character], Oligarch of the [family], leading Family of [city], does not suffer such indignities lightly. He has come to you furious, and demanding revenge. [character] will be greatly pleased if you eliminate these insolent [rival] outside of [city]. He has offered to recruit a band of local Warrior from [city] to help defend the city, but they will require funds for their equipment and upkeep.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Pillaged Industry

options.text: We will see to it that you suffer no financial hardships from this devastation, [character].
I am surprised at you [character]! In times like these, we must all make sacrifices.

events.text: The lands outside the [family] city of [city] are being pillaged by the [rival]! [character], Oligarch of the [family], leading Family of [city], does not suffer such indignities lightly. He has come to you furious, and demanding compensation for your failure to protect [city]. Will you reach into the treasury to make [character] and the [family] whole again?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Stolen Gods

options.text: Refuse to rest until the statue is returned.
Make an oath to build a new home for the gods.
The gods can look after themselves.

events.text: The vile [rival] have committed an unspeakable offense, stealing the statue from [city]. Drastic action must be taken if the gods are not to abandon [rival]!

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Temple in Danger

options.text: We shall make quick work of these [rival] with your brave Warrior Monks!
I admire your courage [character], but we have enough men to handle these brigands.

events.text: Our Holy [religion] city of [city] has suffered a pillaged [improvement] Improvement at the hands of the heretical [rival]! [character], Head of [religion], is concerned for the safety of his <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>Magi in the Temple Zoroastrianism<p=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>Presbyters in the Temple Christianity<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>Kohanim in the Temple Judaism<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>Elect in the Temple Manichaeism<else>Magi in the Temple Zoroastrianism<end> nearby. As such, he is offering to recruit a band of local Warrior from the militant faithful of [city] to help defend the city, but they will require funds for their equipment and upkeep.
